statusReason: UFC is SCAFFOLD_ONLY with fullyBacktestableBouts = 0 (status/ufc-graduation-decision.json). No market family can be backtested leakage-safe today; this ranks the families for WHEN the data foundation is rebuilt, it does not select a market to model now.

moneyline.note: Cleanest settlement (win/loss) + best interpretability. But current 'model' ≈ de-vigged market + ~0 nudge, and the join leaks. Best FIRST family once point-in-time odds + a date-safe join exist.

fight_goes_distance.note: Binary + deterministic settlement (did it reach the final bell). Depends on career finish-rate features that must be snapshotted pre-bout.

method_of_victory.note: Multi-outcome (KO/TKO, sub, decision); harder settlement + thinner samples.

significant_strikes.note: Continuous prop; needs the most feature depth + carries the highest leakage risk.

selectedMarket: moneyline (WHEN the foundation is rebuilt; NOT now)
evidence: Moneyline scores highest on settlement clarity + interpretability. But every family shares historicalCoverage=1 (no backtestable bouts) → INSUFFICIENT overall.
rejectedAlternatives: Props (sig strikes, takedowns) rejected as a FIRST market — highest leakage risk + thinnest samples.
requiredBaseline: de-vig closing market probability (moneyline), point-in-time joined
graduationCriteria: beat the de-vig market baseline on Brier + log loss, out-of-sample, chronological split; calibrated; no unresolved leakage — mirrors the MLB gate.
